notable_absence.finding: No Capella management-plane role gate on UPSERT either - consistent with every other DML/DDL statement in this round, confirming the model extends cleanly.

cross_component_finding: This page makes the Advanced-credential requirement's internal logic explicit and conjunctive, not disjunctive: 'To execute the following statement, your client must have either the `Write` or both the `Query Update` and `Query Insert` privileges on `hotel`.' UPSERT (being INSERT+UPDATE combined) requires BOTH Query Update AND Query Insert together under Advanced credentials - a conjunctive privilege requirement - which is structurally different from the disjunctive combination logic of requiresCapellaRole (any ONE of organization-owner/project-owner/project-data-writer suffices). The credential-type-keyed privilege family therefore supports both AND and OR combination semantics depending on the statement, which the registry's current relation shapes (requiresPrivilege, incompatibleWithCredentialType) don't yet distinguish - worth flagging for reconciliation to decide whether combination logic (any-of vs. all-of) needs to be captured as relation metadata.
